295: The Prohibition of (القزع), Shaving part of the head and leaving part and the permissibility of shaving the entire head for men and not women.
296: The Prohibition of joining hair, Permanently marking skin, Shaping of Teeth
297: The Prohibition of pulling out white hairs from the beard, the head or other parts of the body and from pulling out hair from the beard as it begins to grow.
298: It is disliked to make istinjaa with the right hand and to touch the private parts with the right hand without a reason in the shariah
299: It is disliked to walk in one shoe or sock without a valid reason in the shariah and it is also disliked to put on a shoe or leather sock while standing without a valid reason reason in the shariah
300: The Prohibition of leaving a fire in your house while going to sleeping or the likes of it whether it is contained in a lamp or not
301: The Prohibitation of exerting/burdening oneself in actions or statements in which there is no beneifit or no need
302: The Prohibition of Raising one's voice in a crying manner over the dead and to slap one's cheek, to rip one's clothes, to pull out or shave one's hair and to call for destruction on oneself
303: The Prohibition of going to the (الكهّان)Those who claim to have knowledge of the future, the (المنجمين) those who look at the stars and claim to make predictions of the future, the (العراف) those who claim to have knowledge on the unseen matters of present and past, (أصحاب الرّمل) those who use sand or gravel to predict the course of actions that a person should take, (الطوارق بالحصى وبالشعير ونحو ذلك) those who use stones or barley grains and the likes of it to predict the course of actions that a person should take.
304: The Prohibition of Believing in Omens
305: The Prohibition of forming an image of an animal on a blanket, or a rock, or a garmet, or a coin, or a pillow, or gold or silver coins,or a mat, or other than that. And The Prohibition of having an image formed on a wall, or a ceiling, or a covering/curtain,  or a Turban or the likes of it. And The Command to destroy these images.
306: The Prohibition of Taking a Dog Except to Hunt or for Livestock or for Crops
307: It is Disliked to Hang a Bell on a Camel and Other Animals and it is Disliked to be Accompanied by a Dog or a Bell in Travel
308: It is Disliked to Ride (الجلّالة) and it is a Camel or a She camel which eats Waste, Then if it eats pure feed then it's meat becomes pure and the dislike is removed
309: The Prohibition of Spitting in the Masjid and the Command to Remove it When it is Found in it and the Command to Purify the Masjid from Filth
310: The Prohibitation of Having Arguments in the Masjid or to Raising  One's Voices in it or to Call Out to Something That Has Been Lost or to Buy and Sell or to Have a Rental Agreement and the Likes of it From Other Transactions
311: The Prohibition of One Who Eats Garlic or Onion or Leek or Other Than it from What has a Disliked Scent, it is Prohibited That They Enter the Masjid Before the Scent Ceases Except for Necessity
312: It is Disliked (الاحتباء) Sitting With Legs Towards the Chest on the Day of Jummah While the Imam is Giving the Khutbah Because he can Reach a State of Sleep and Miss Hearing the Khutbah and it is Feared that the Wudu Would Break
313: The Prohibition of the One Who Enters in the 10 Days of Dhul Hijjah and Intends to Sacrifice, from Removing Anything from their Hair or Nails Until the Sacrifice
314: The Prohibition of Swearing with Anything that is Created like The Prophet and The Kabah and The Angel and The Sky and The Parents and Life and The Soul and The Head and The Good a Leader has Been Given and The Dirt of a Person and A Trust, And it is from the Most Intense Prohibitions
315: The Harsh consequences of the One who takes an oath while intentionally lying
